title: Studio Atmosphere Studies
description: Five independent studies of recording-room objects, corners, and acoustic moods that support live-session campaign imagery.
creative_direction: Independent images should feel like believable parts of a live-session campaign: room corners, instrument still lifes, practical light, and tactile studio materials translated into poster-friendly square frames.
